checks.claim: the reward popup still labels its slots with the classes getRewardTypeBySlot maps
instructions: Trigger any reward popup (daily reward, path-of-valor claim, mission reward).

Every class must fall under one of: cur attribute, shards_girl_ico, slot_avatar (+girl_ico), girl-shards-slot, slot_girl_shards, slot_random_girl, mythic, slot_scrolls_*, slot_seasonal_event_cash, data-d, or the possible-rewards list.
A class that matches none of those is the drift: getRewardTypeBySlot returns 'undetected' for it.

checks.claim: market_equip_booster still accepts action/id_item/type
instructions: This is a write. Equip one booster by hand with the network tab open.
Expect a POST to /ajax.php with action=market_equip_booster, id_item=<numeric>, type=booster, answering {success:true}.
If the game renamed the action or the parameter, the equip path dies silently -- HHauto only sees success:false.

checks.claim: the mythic upgrade page addresses a worn item by id_member_item_equipped
instructions: Take a worn mythic below level 20 and open /mythic-equipment-upgrade.html?id_member_item_equipped=<id>.
Expect the upgrade page for that item. A bounce back to the market means the parameter changed -- that was the August 2026 bug.
Also confirm item_to_upgrade.level in the console: it is captured at page build and does NOT follow a level-up in the same page.
